root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: When the final odd-tail 4-bit sample is accounted, `i == ptr->sampleCount - 1`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: On the `ptr->sampleSize == 4` odd-tail path, the shared `ptr->sizes[i]` accounting epilogue must consume the last valid slot (`ptr->sampleCount - 1`) rather than the post-increment loop index. Otherwise the common `ptr->max_size`, `ptr->total_size`, and `ptr->total_samples` updates dereference `ptr->sizes[i]` after the last written sample.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the shared accounting epilogue with `i == 108` while `ptr->sampleCount - 1 == 106`, so the dereference uses a slot beyond the 107-element allocation. The fixed original accounts the odd-tail sample while `i == 106` before incrementing.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace violates the required predicate at `sample_size_accounting` (`accounting_index=108`, `last_valid_index=106`) while the protected accounting event executes. The fixed original reaches the same semantic accounting event genuinely with `accounting_index=106`, `last_valid_index=106`.

nodes.description: On the final 4-bit odd-tail iteration, `i += 2` advances the loop index past the last written slot, leaving `i == 108` before the shared accounting epilogue.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `odd_tail_iteration_post.post_increment_index=108` immediately after the case-4 `i += 2`.

nodes.description: The shared `ptr->sizes[i]` accounting epilogue uses the carried post-increment loop index as its subscript at the crash site.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `sample_size_accounting.accounting_index=108` at the shared accounting event.

edges.relation: The same post-increment `i` value produced by the final 4-bit odd-tail iteration is carried unchanged into the shared accounting epilogue and reused as the `ptr->sizes[i]` subscript.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace shows `odd_tail_iteration_post.post_increment_index == sample_size_accounting.accounting_index == 108`.
